name: English

messages.cli.usage:
xljs - Excel/CSV script runner

Usage:
  xljs [options] <script.js|script.ts> [args...]
  xljs pack <script> [-o out.exe]    create an exe with the script embedded
  xljs check <script>                check syntax and imports without running
  xljs init [dir]                    write type definitions (xljs.d.ts) and jsconfig.json
  xljs dev [script|folder]           development mode: AI chat, compare, run, versions
  xljs vba <book.xlsm>... [-o out.txt]  write the VBA code of macro workbooks to one text file
  xljs version                       print the version

Options:
  --dev                              open the script in the development mode (like xljs dev)
  --ui=auto|native|console|mock      UI to use (default: auto)
  --ui-answers=<file.json>           answers file for the mock UI
  --lang=auto|{0}                  message language (default: system language)
  --debug[=script|window]            debug: script = run the script in a debugger window
                                     (WebView2 developer tools: breakpoints, stepping);
                                     window = only enable developer tools (F12) in windows
  --watchdog=<seconds>|on|off       ask whether to stop a script that runs this long
                                     without responding (endless loop; default: 15
                                     seconds with the native UI, off otherwise)
  --stop-key=<key>|on|off            ask whether to stop the running script when the key
                                     is pressed (esc, f12, ctrl+shift+q...; Windows; default:
                                     esc with the native UI, off otherwise)

XLJS_UI / XLJS_UI_ANSWERS / XLJS_LANG / XLJS_DEBUG / XLJS_WATCHDOG / XLJS_STOP_KEY environment variables work too (for packed exes).
